ARABIC — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Phonological awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness: Pronunciation.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

   A. Only memorise without using the language

   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
